quote: Whenever any vehicle is stopped at a marked crosswalk or at any unmarked crosswalk at an intersection to permit a pedestrian to cross the roadway, the driver of any other vehicle approaching from the rear shall not overtake and pass such stopped vehicle.

activation.description: A vehicle stopped at a marked or unmarked intersection crosswalk to permit pedestrian crossing, with another vehicle approaching from rear
activation.source_clause: Whenever any vehicle is stopped at a marked crosswalk or at any unmarked crosswalk at an intersection to permit a pedestrian to cross the roadway

obligation.description: The rear approaching driver shall not overtake and pass the stopped vehicle
obligation.source_clause: the driver of any other vehicle approaching from the rear shall not overtake and pass such stopped vehicle

timing.description: Continuous stopped-lead and pedestrian crossing interval; no numeric legal cutoff

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: stopped at a marked crosswalk or at any unmarked crosswalk at an intersection
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original map and crossing review must establish the marked or unmarked intersection reference.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: to permit a pedestrian to cross the roadway
judgment_calls_needed.note: Lead rest and pedestrian proximity alone do not establish the purpose of the stop.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: any other vehicle approaching from the rear
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original Native ego/lead directions and full bodies must establish rear approach.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: shall not overtake and pass such stopped vehicle
judgment_calls_needed.note: Measure adjacent longitudinal overlap and getting ahead during crossing; do not infer legal outcome from a controller request.
